# Delegated Brand

> A reference implementation of Brand as Infrastructure, built to test The Delegated Brand (Dominik Ziller, DZGN Research). A template for a brand that people and AI agents read from the same files, following the Open Knowledge Format v0.3. Read AGENTS.md first.

## Start here

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): read order, answering rules (yes, no, handover), revision rules
- [README.md](README.md): what each part is, why it exists, how the parts connect

## Template

- [bundle/index.md](bundle/index.md): entry point, owner, token file, reading list by task
- [bundle/core.md](bundle/core.md): the one idea, read first
- [bundle/facts.md](bundle/facts.md): the only source for facts
- [bundle/glossary/](bundle/glossary/index.md): rule templates

## Example

- [example/index.md](example/index.md): Kurbelwerk Hessling, a fictional manufacturer with every rule type, several owners and an agent that handles quotes

## Optional

- [prompts/new-brand.md](prompts/new-brand.md): set up a new brand with an agent
- [prompts/use-brand.md](prompts/use-brand.md): brief an agent with the bundle
- [scripts/](scripts/check_bundle.py): approve, check and export the bundle
- [evals/rubric.md](evals/rubric.md): review checklist
- [evals/README.md](evals/README.md): test cases
- [Brand Infrastructure Report 2026](https://dzgn.work/brand-infrastructure-report-2026/): the frame and the evidence
